title: Exactness of the algebra-valued finite sheaf-Hom functor
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $A=f_*\mathcal O_X$ finite locally free [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Write $T:\operatorname{Mod}(A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$ for scalar restriction [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. For any functor $H:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ with natural isomorphism $H T\cong\mathcal Hom(A,-)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], $H$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits. No finiteness of the morphism or quasi-coherence of the coefficient module is required.

source.place: Tag 0BUZ, lemma-compute-sheafhom-affine; finite locally free tensor exactness (Tags 01C6 and 05NE)

proof.text: The finite locally free dual of A is finite locally free. Use dual_tensor_hom_iso and its naturality to form a natural isomorphism from tensorLeft(dual A) to Hom(A,-). Tensor exactness and the specified iH transfer finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation to H followed by T.

Restriction of scalars preserves finite limits and colimits by the recorded scalar-restriction declarations. It reflects isomorphisms: after forgetting to abelian sheaves, its map of a morphism is the identical morphism; the module-to-sheaf functor reflects isomorphisms. Mathlib reflectsLimitsOfShape_of_reflectsIsomorphisms and its colimit counterpart give finite-limit and finite-colimit reflection. Apply preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves and its colimit counterpart to H and T.
